A '''H-type Nubian yacht''' was [[pilot]]ed by [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Gender|She]] was given the [[Starship|vessel]] after a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|failed assassination attempt]] destroyed her [[J-type diplomatic barge|previous ship]]. Amidala used it to travel to [[Tatooine]] and [[Geonosis]] with [[Anakin Skywalker]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], Amidala used the ship<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> to travel to alleged negotiations with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. It was however intercepted by [[General]] [[Grievous]]'s [[flagship]] ''[[Malevolence]]'' and pulled aboard via a tractor beam, in the hopes of capturing Amidala and using her as a hostage to force the Republic fleet attacking the ''Malevolence'' to stand down. However, Amidala set the yacht's power system to overload to act as a distraction and take out any droids that came to capture her; the yacht exploded shortly after Grievous himself boarded it, destroying the two battle droids with him, but the cyborg survived.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />
